source: right eyehole of the masked office view at mask-on, 1280x576 screenrecord downscaled to 320x144, crop x175-270 y55-110; frames at 5 fps from flash-5.6 s; occupant = pixels with luma >= 12 in the crop (an empty window shows only the mask rim, ~500 px at hue ~352)

colourRule.WitheredChica: eyehole hue 34-49 sat >= 0.6; office (camdrop) hue ~49 sat 0.6
colourRule.WitheredFreddyInHall: office hue ~21 sat ~0.32 with the doorway beam (not an encounter)
colourRule.empty: eyehole: ~500 px at hue ~352 (mask rim); office: grey 7 700 px (full beam) or 2 730 px (faint beam), sat <= 0.17
colourRule.tieBreak: the camdrop frame (higher resolution, unmasked) decides when the eyehole hue sits at the Chica/Freddy border

night5-hallfix.330: W.Freddy? (hue 16, sat 0.79 -- strongest candidate, awaiting the operator)

limits: Mangle hangs from the ceiling top-right, outside the eyeholes (operator): this corpus sees Withered encounters only, so encounter counts from it are lower bounds
Balloon Boy stands front-left; no left-eyehole event was seen in 64 windows
Toy characters were not seen; the route pins them on stage
purpose: training and validation corpus for attack identification in the masked view; per-cycle encounter identity is the open candidate for what separates a dimmed flash from a refused one after an encounter

camdropWitness.method: frames at camdrop tap +0.20..+0.75 s (10 fps, 640x288 downscale), region x300-600 y40-140 (upper-right office below the HUD text); monitor-map frames (>=2500 near-grey bright px) skipped; occupant = saturated mass: Chica hue ~49 sat 0.6 (~10 000 px), Bonnie hue 239 sat 0.3 (~7 600 px), Freddy-in-office hue 20 sat 0.66 (8 400 px), Freddy-in-hall hue 21 sat 0.32 (~7 840 px, the doorway beam lighting him); empty office = grey 7 700 px (full beam) or 2 730 px (faint beam), sat <= 0.17
camdropWitness.indexRule: the camdrop sampled at "flash X" is the one 3.6 s AFTER that flash and belongs to mask window X+10 s; re-indexed, it agrees with the eyehole witness cycle for cycle

hallfix.320->330: FREDDY in the office = eyehole brown candidate

inHallDoorway: foxyfix 70, 80, 90, 100 s camdrops (four consecutive cycles, his approach)
freddy.verdict: classifier + this session by eye; operator verdict pending

camdropWitness.reading: the camdrop instant shows the encounter itself: the character is already in the office when the monitor drops, and the mask goes on 0.45 s later to repel it; the same frame shows who stands in the hall
camdropWitness.operatorReading: 2026-09-12: the hue-21/sat-0.32 signature is Withered Freddy lit in the hall during the monitor-down animation; the grey signatures are an empty hall, dark or lit; hallfix 320 s is Freddy inside the office (check.png: Chica in the office at 90 s, Freddy in the office at 320 s). All camdrop classes confirmed.
camdropWitness.hallSightingsAndFlashes: Freddy in the hall at the camdrops of foxyfix 70-100 s; the flashes 6.4 s later (80-110 s) were all LIT -- consistent with the 300-frame hall-movement latch having expired if he stood still

operatorVerdict2: 2026-09-12: every '?' in the eyehole corpus is a dark (empty) eyehole; every other colour guess correct except hallfix 210 s (Chica, not Freddy). Eyehole rule 19/20; eyehole + camdrop 20/20.

night5-hallfix (41 cycles).note: eyehole 90 s Chica-hued with no camdrop occupant in the previous cycle's frame -- counted from the eyehole

mangleWitness.method: camdrop frames (monitor just down), 640x288 downscale, region x190-500 y20-145 (upper-centre of the office, where she hangs from the ceiling; the top-right box first used caught only the tip of her arm); score = pale/white-pink pixels (luma >= 110, |r-g| < 40) and red pixels (r >= 120, g < 90)
mangleWitness.calibrationFrames: the monitor-down frame ~0.1 s before her jumpscare on night5-anchor1, anchor4, anchor5 -- read as Mangle by this session; operator confirmation pending (Pedro noted no Mangle frame had been confirmed by him)
mangleWitness.traced runs: night5-hallfix and night6-foxyfix camdrop frames: pale max 34 px over 64 cycles -- zero Mangle sightings, now a measurement rather than a blind spot
mangleWitness.alsoInThoseFrames: anchor1: Withered Bonnie in the hall doorway behind her; anchor5: Balloon Boy in the office beside her
mangleWitness.operatorCorrection: 2026-09-13: the calibration frames show Mangle's JUMPSCARE ONSET, not Mangle dormant in the office waiting to confirm the kill; frame 2 (anchor1 273.85) also shows Foxy and Bonnie in a lit hall; frame 4 (anchor4 367.67) shows only the monitor down/lowering; frame 6 a lit hall; frames 8-9 (anchor5) Balloon Boy in the office while Mangle finishes. The detector is therefore validated on the attack pose only; the dormant pose is still unconfirmed.
